Questions, answered

Are these final prices?

No — prices shown are typical starter prices so the store is fully shoppable as a preview. When you connect your dropship supplier, swap in their real prices, shipping times, and product photos in this same layout.

How long does shipping take?

Most dropship suppliers ship in 5–10 business days. Exact windows depend on the supplier and item — each product will show its live estimate once your supplier feed is connected. Free shipping applies over $50 in this starter setup.

What power supply do I need for LED strips?

Check the strip voltage (most are 12V or 24V — never mix them), add up its watts, then size the supply 20% higher. Example: 40W of strip → at least a 48W supply. The Essentials Trio covers most single-strip runs.

Will the car headlights fit my vehicle?

Match the bulb size in your owner's manual (common sizes: 9005, H11, 9012). LitCasa auto listings are plug-and-play for those sizes — if your size isn't listed, message support before ordering.

What spectrum do grow lights use?

LitCasa grow panels are full-spectrum (sunlight-like white plus red/blue boost) — good for seedlings through harvest for herbs, greens, and houseplants.

What if something arrives damaged?

Contact LitCasa within 30 days with a photo and your order number for a replacement or refund through the supplier's warranty process.
